content.value_statement: Airflow pipelines are hard to keep reliable across retries, sensors, alerts, and tests. This skill provides proven DAG patterns, checklists, and templates for production workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains DAG design principles for idempotent, atomic, incremental, and observable tasks.
Provides TaskFlow API, dynamic DAG, branching, sensor, alerting, and testing examples.
Shows dependency patterns for linear, fan-out, fan-in, and complex workflows.
Covers retries, timeouts, catchup, max active runs, and failure callbacks.
Lists project structure and best practices for DAG modules, plugins, and tests.
limitations: Does not inspect a live Airflow deployment or validate cluster settings.
Examples require adaptation to your providers, connections, credentials, and schedules.
Does not replace staging tests before backfills or schedule changes.
Does not cover every Airflow provider or managed Airflow platform.

use_cases.title: Design a New ETL DAG
use_cases.description: Plan tasks, dependencies, retries, schedules, and observability before writing a production pipeline.

use_cases.title: Harden Existing Workflows
use_cases.description: Review sensors, alerts, timeouts, and project structure to improve reliability and operator behavior.

use_cases.title: Create DAG Test Coverage
use_cases.description: Add DagBag checks, dependency assertions, and unit tests for task logic before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic ETL DAG
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new scheduled pipeline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design an Apache Airflow DAG for [source] to [target]. Include schedule, tasks, dependencies, retries, and alerts.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Dependency Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this workflow: [workflow summary]. Recommend Airflow dependency patterns, branch logic, and trigger rules for reliable execution.

prompt_templates.title: Add Sensors and Alerting
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this Airflow pipeline for external dependencies. Add sensor strategy, timeout settings, failure callbacks, and operational notes.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor for Production
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced hardening of an existing Airflow project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Airflow DAG design: [design details]. Recommend changes for idempotency, tests, dynamic DAGs, backfills, and deployment structure.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a daily customer ETL DAG design.
output_examples.output: A DAG plan with extract, transform, load, start and end tasks, retry settings, max active runs, and alert callbacks.

output_examples.input: A user has a DAG that waits for files and another upstream DAG.
output_examples.output: A sensor plan covering S3 checks, external task waits, reschedule mode, timeout values, and downstream processing behavior.

output_examples.input: A user wants confidence before deploying Airflow changes.
output_examples.output: A testing checklist with DagBag loading checks, dependency assertions, cycle checks, and task logic tests.

best_practices: Define idempotent tasks so retries and backfills do not duplicate data.
Use reschedule mode and timeouts for sensors that wait on external systems.
Validate DAG loading, dependencies, and task logic before production deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not put heavy business logic directly inside DAG definition files.
Do not change production schedules without approval and staging validation.
Do not use shared global state across tasks that should be stateless.

faq.question: What Airflow versions does this skill target?
faq.answer: It focuses on modern Airflow patterns, including the TaskFlow API introduced in Airflow 2.

faq.question: Can it generate a complete production DAG?
faq.answer: It can draft a strong DAG design, but you must adapt connections, credentials, providers, and environment settings.

faq.question: Does it help with sensors?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers file sensors, S3 sensors, external DAG waits, custom sensors, timeouts, and reschedule mode.

faq.question: Does it include testing guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes DagBag loading checks, dependency assertions, cycle checks, and task-level unit test ideas.

faq.question: Can it replace Airflow documentation?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes patterns and examples, but official documentation remains the source for provider-specific behavior.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production changes?
faq.answer: Use it for planning and review, then validate changes in staging before schedule changes, backfills, or deployments.
